headline: Certification of the General Election results, plus discussion of Ethics training and financial disclosure forms.
summary: The Rhode Island Ethics Commission requires board members to complete Ethics training and an annual Financial Disclosure Statement. The agenda also includes approval of minutes from November 3 and November 5, 2026.

Posted on 11/23/2026 
 
Town of South Kingstown  
Canvassing Authority  
Regular Session Meeting Agenda   
Wednesday, November 25, 2026 at 12:00 PM   
Town Hall Council Chambers 
180 High Street 
Wakefield RI 02879 
www.southkingstownri.gov  
Walter A. Young, Jr., Chair 
Sarah L. Vaccaro, Vice Chair 
Elaine D. Shanley, Member 
David Cote, Alt. Member (R) 
Paul A. McConnell, Alt. Member 
(D) 
  
1. Call to Order 
2. Approval of Minutes 
 A. November 3, 2026 
 B. November 5, 2026 
3. New Business 
Certify the results of the General Election. 
 A. Certify the results from the General Election. 
 B. Discussion of Ethics training and annual Financial Disclosure Statement for Board members required by the 
Rhode Island Ethics Commission. 
 C. All other matters of concern.
